statement: The system shall allow the Customer to add multiple distinct products to a shopping cart.
The system shall allow the Customer to specify the desired quantity of each item in the shopping cart.
Before finalizing checkout, the system shall verify the current inventory availability of every item in the shopping cart.
If any cart item is out of stock, the system shall alert the Customer of the stock shortage.
condition: if any cart item out of stock

statement: If any cart item is out of stock, the system shall halt the checkout transaction.
condition: if any cart item out of stock

statement: Upon successful checkout confirmation, the system shall generate a new order in the draft state.
The system shall calculate the final total amount of each new order.
The system shall securely transmit the order total and transaction details to the external Payment Gateway for processing.
qualifier: request to PaymentGateway; securely; order total + transaction details

statement: If the Payment Gateway confirms a successful transaction, the system shall transition the order to the placed state.
If the Payment Gateway reports a declined transaction, the system shall transition the order to the payment failed state.
If the Payment Gateway reports a declined transaction, the system shall alert the Customer of the payment failure.
The system shall allow Warehouse staff to mark a placed order as picked once its items have been retrieved from the shelves.
condition: if order in placed state; items retrieved

statement: The system shall allow Warehouse staff to mark a picked order as packed once all required items have been boxed.
The system shall allow Warehouse staff to mark a packed order as shipped once it has been handed over to an external carrier.
The system shall allow the Customer to cancel an order only while it is in the placed state and has not been marked as picked.
condition: if order in placed state and not picked

statement: When a valid cancellation is made, the system shall transition the order to the cancelled state.
When a valid cancellation is made, the system shall immediately instruct the Payment Gateway to execute a full reversal of funds.
The system shall allow the Customer to initiate a return request for a shipped order within a 30-day window.
The system shall allow Warehouse staff to record the physical receipt of returned items.
The system shall allow Warehouse staff to approve returned items after receipt.
condition: after physical receipt of returned items

statement: Once the Warehouse approves the returned items, the system shall issue a refund to the Customer.
The system shall allow Sales staff to search for an order by its unique order identifier.
The system shall display to Sales staff the current state of a retrieved order.
The system shall display to Sales staff the historical timeline of state changes of a retrieved order.
The system shall allow Sales staff to correct a Customer's delivery address on an order before the order reaches the packed state.
The system shall generate a daily summary report of total processed revenue and total number of shipped orders for Sales staff.
qualifier: total processed revenue; shipped order count; for Sales

statement: The system shall complete order search, cart update, and checkout submission requests with a 95th-percentile response time of no more than 2 seconds, measured at the API boundary under a nominal load of up to 500 concurrent sessions.
condition: order search, cart update, checkout submission; <= 500 concurrent sessions

statement: The system shall sustain 2,000 concurrent user sessions while meeting the 2-second 95th-percentile response time, with a request error rate of no more than 0.1%.
The system shall encrypt all customer payment data using TLS 1.2 or higher in transit and AES-256 at rest.
The system shall not store unencrypted primary account numbers in any log, database, or backup.

The system shall record an immutable audit entry for every order state change, capturing the UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, the acting role, the prior state, and the resulting state, modifiable by no role.
qualifier: immutable; timestamp UTC ms; acting role; prior state; resulting state; modifiable by no role

statement: The system shall retain audit entries for at least 12 months.
The system shall achieve at least 99.9% availability per calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced at least 48 hours in advance.
condition: per calendar month; excluding maintenance announced >= 48 h ahead

statement: The system shall time out payment authorization requests to the Payment Gateway after 30 seconds.
The system shall ensure that a retried payment authorization for the same order results in no more than one charge against the customer's payment method.
condition: on retried authorization for the same order

statement: The system shall roll back any partially completed order transaction in full within 60 seconds of failure detection, leaving no order in an intermediate state and no discrepancy between financial records and inventory counts.
qualifier: partially completed transaction; within 60 s; in full; no intermediate state; financial records consistent with inventory

statement: The system shall support a 3x increase in peak daily order volume without modification to application code or data model, verified by load test against the projected peak.
qualifier: 3x peak daily volume; no code or data model change

statement: Each order shall comprise one or more order lines, each recording a product, its quantity, and its unit price.
The system shall reject a cancellation request for an order that is not in the placed state or has already been picked, and inform the Customer.
condition: if order not in placed state or already picked

statement: The system shall reject a return request submitted more than 30 days after shipment.
condition: if more than 30 days after shipment

statement: The system shall reject a delivery address correction for an order that has reached the packed state or later.
When the Warehouse approves a return, the system shall transition the order to the returned state.
When a refund or payment reversal is completed, the system shall transition the order to the refunded state.
The system shall reserve inventory for the ordered quantities when an order is placed.
The system shall release reserved inventory when an order is cancelled.
The system shall record the carrier and tracking number of each shipment.
The system shall alert the Customer when an order is shipped.
The system shall interface with the external Payment Gateway through a secure API that supports payment authorization and full payment reversal.
The system shall restrict order search, delivery address correction, and daily report access to users in the Sales role.
